$comment: State-suppression ledger (RAIL-STATE-SUPPRESSION-01). Two-directional ratchet: an unledgered leak or a stale entry fails. A declared suppresses.categories that the CSS does not honour. Independent of the pseudo-state rail — a dimension can be REALIZED and its suppression contract violated simultaneously, which is why Button scores realized while a disabled Button still takes :hover border-color. `reachability` grades whether the leak can manifest on that root today; unreachable entries are ledgered for accounting, not ignored.
